description: Dashboard: channel filter + per-channel breakdown UI (plan tasks 6-8). Add a channel selector serialized in getPhaseParams() so it re-scopes every metric card and composes with phase + active/new; add a per-channel breakdown section (installs, activation, wallet growth, cohort retention, raw count beside each rate, small-sample suppression, clearly-labeled organic row) with plain caveat copy that iOS link installs appear under organic here and attribution is directional not exact. DEPENDS ON FEAT-001 (needs the /details/channels endpoint and the ?channel= backend filter). Deploy the dashboard.
steps: Task 6: in src/dashboard.ts add currentChannel state (default '' = All channels), a <select> near the phase/cohort controls populated at refresh from the channels present in /details/channels data plus an 'All channels' (value '') default and 'Organic / untagged' (value 'organic') entry, and setChannel(v) that updates state, clears any per-panel cohort override, and calls refresh(). In getPhaseParams(cohortOverride?) append `&channel=<label>` when currentChannel is non-empty — this single serializer already feeds /kpis and every /details/* fetch. Remember inner-JS interpolation is escaped as \${...} inside the DASHBOARD_HTML template literal.

Task 7: add a breakdown section that fetches /details/channels (with getPhaseParams()) and renders one row/card per channel + the organic row showing installs, activation (rate + raw count), wallet growth, and cohort retention (D7/D30 with cohort denominator). Show the raw count next to each percentage; when the server returns smallSample/rate:null, render 'n/a' with the count shown instead of a fragile percentage (reuse the existing retention n/a rendering). Clearly label the organic/untagged entry. Add static caveat copy near the section: iOS link installs appear under organic here (real iOS channel data lives in App Store Connect), and attribution is directional, not exact. (Req 5.3, 9.1, 9.2 — explainability copy ships WITH the metric per the insights-explainability steering rule.)

Task 8 (deploy — operator step if creds present): cd analytics-worker && npm run deploy. Load /dashboard?secret=<DASHBOARD_SECRET> and visually confirm the selector + breakdown appear, re-scope all cards, compose with phase + cohort, and read correctly against current all-organic data. If deploy creds are unavailable here, record that deploy is an operator step and rely on the typecheck + the FEAT-001 /details/channels contract — do NOT block the branch.
acceptance_criteria: A channel selector exists with 'All channels' default and an 'Organic / untagged' entry, populated from channels present in the data; selecting a channel re-scopes every metric card and composes with phase + active/new.
getPhaseParams() serializes &channel=<label> as the single source of truth so it flows to /kpis and every /details/* fetch.

A per-channel breakdown section renders one row per channel + a clearly-labeled organic row with installs, activation, wallet growth, and cohort retention, showing the raw count beside each percentage and 'n/a' (with count) for small samples.
Dashboard copy plainly states iOS link installs appear under organic here (real iOS data in App Store Connect) and that attribution is directional, not exact.
cd analytics-worker && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json passes.
verification: cd analytics-worker && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json  (must pass)

Live visual check after deploy at /dashboard?secret=<DASHBOARD_SECRET>: channel selector re-scopes all cards; breakdown renders from /details/channels with distinct organic row, raw counts beside rates, and n/a for small samples; caveat copy visible; channel composes with phase + cohort. If deploy creds unavailable, state this is an operator step in findings.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED (dashboard channel filter + per-channel breakdown UI, plan tasks 6-7; task 8 deploy + live visual check is a pending operator step).

FILE CHANGED: analytics-worker/src/dashboard.ts only (no app src/, app.json, ios/, android/ touched).

TASK 6 (channel selector + getPhaseParams single source of truth):
- Added `currentChannel` state (default '' = All channels) next to currentPhase/currentCohort.
- Added a new #channel-filter row (reusing the .phase-filter styling) with a <select id="channel-select" onchange="setChannel(this.value)"> seeded with two static options: 'All channels' (value '') and 'Organic / untagged' (value 'organic'). Added a .phase-filter select CSS rule so it matches the phase/cohort controls.
- Added setChannel(value): sets currentChannel, clears activeDetailCohort (an explicit global change takes over an open drill-down, same pattern as setCohort), and calls refresh().
- getPhaseParams(cohortOverride?) now appends `&channel=<encoded currentChannel>` when currentChannel is non-empty, AFTER the from/to/cohort appends. This is the single serializer, so the channel scope flows unchanged to /kpis and every /details/* fetch (fetchKPIs + fetchDetail both call getPhaseParams). 'organic' and any specific label are passed as-is; the backend (FEAT-001 buildChannelClause) maps 'organic' => channel IS NULL, a label => channel = ?, '' => no predicate.

TASK 7 (per-channel breakdown section + caveat copy):
- Added a 'Channel Breakdown' section at the end of render()'s HTML: an intro .detail line, a caveat .detail line, and a #channel-breakdown container. render() calls loadChannelBreakdown() after painting (and after re-opening any active drill-down).
- loadChannelBreakdown() fetches /details/channels via fetchDetail('channels') — which uses getPhaseParams(), so the breakdown composes with phase + Users. The endpoint deliberately ignores &channel (strips it server-side) so this table always spans EVERY channel regardless of the selector; the intro copy states this.
- Renders one <tr> per channel from data.channels: columns Channel | Installs | Activation | Wallet Growth | D7 Retention | D30 Retention.
  - rateCell(rate,num,den): raw count (num/den) ALWAYS shown beside the rate; when rate is null (server smallSample/suppressed) renders greyed 'n/a' with the count instead of a fragile percentage. Reuses the existing retentionValue() n/a convention for color.
  - retentionCell(horizon): uses the existing retentionValue(pct) for the D7/D30 pct (greyed 'n/a' when server pct is null = cohort too recent/empty) and always shows the cohort denominator '(cohort N)'.
  - The organic/untagged row is clearly labeled ('Organic / untagged', bold, light-grey row background) via channelLabel('organic').
- populateChannelSelect(channels): on each refresh, repopulates the <select> with the two static entries plus any non-organic channel labels present in the data (sorted), preserves the current selection, and keeps a label the user had selected even if it is no longer present (so the scope is not silently reset). Fixed a shadowing bug (renamed rateCell params so they don't shadow the global num() formatter).

CAVEAT / EXPLAINABILITY COPY (ships WITH the metric per insights-explainability steering): the section states plainly that iOS link installs appear under Organic / untagged (Apple does not pass the tag through the App Store; real iOS per-channel data lives in App Store Connect) and that attribution is directional, not exact.

/details/channels RESPONSE SHAPE CONSUMED (from FEAT-001): { channels: [ { channel: string ('organic' for untagged), installs: number, activation: {rate: number|null, num, den}, walletGrowth: {count}, retention: {"7": {pct: number|null, cohort}, "30": {pct: number|null, cohort}}, smallSample: boolean } ] }. The UI reads retention['7'] / retention['30'] (string keys, matching computeCohortRetention's Record<number,...> JSON serialization), activation.rate===null for small samples, and renders accordingly.

VERIFICATION DONE HERE:
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` => PASS (dashboard.ts is a template-literal string so tsc only gates the module shell; see next line for inner-JS proof).
- Extracted the inner <script> from DASHBOARD_HTML and ran `node --check` on it => parses OK (confirms the template literal is still balanced and the added inner JS is syntactically valid; the \${...} escaping of KPI interpolation is intact and my concatenation-based breakdown markup uses no ${}).
- `npm test` => 22 pass / 0 fail (7 retention + 15 channel; unchanged from FEAT-001 baseline — no dashboard unit tests exist, UI is string HTML).

HONEST VERIFICATION SPLIT: typecheck + inner-JS syntax check + the FEAT-001 /details/channels contract are proven here. The LIVE behavior — selector re-scopes every card, composes with phase + Users, breakdown renders correctly against real data, caveat visible — is NOT proven here because it needs a deploy (`cd analytics-worker && npm run deploy`) + the live dashboard at /dashboard?secret=<DASHBOARD_SECRET>, which require operator wrangler auth + DASHBOARD_SECRET unavailable in this environment.

PENDING OPERATOR STEP (plan task 8 — NOT a blocker): `cd analytics-worker && npm run deploy`, then load /dashboard?secret=<DASHBOARD_SECRET> and confirm the Channel selector + Channel Breakdown section appear, the selector re-scopes all metric cards, composes with phase + active/new, and reads correctly against the current all-organic data (pre-app-release everything is organic). NOTE this depends on FEAT-001's own pending operator step (remote migration 0005 + worker deploy) having run first, since the dashboard calls /details/channels and the &channel= param added by FEAT-001.
